Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

MALLETS FOR USE IN FOUNDRIES 



(Reaffirmed 2003) 



1. Scope— Covers the requirements for mallets for use In foundries. 

2. Application — Mallets are used for mild rapping and application of light force. 

3. Dimensions — Dimensions and weights for mallets are specified in Tables 1 and 2.

4. Material 

4.1 Handle — Seasoned hardwood. 

4.2 Head — Seasoned hardwood or hard rubber. 

4.3 Collar— MWd steel. 

4.4 W^dge ~ MUd steel 

5- Tolerances — Coarse class 15:2102-1^69 'Allowable deviations for dimensions without specified 
tolerances ( first revision ) \ 

6. Coating — Any suitable varnish or lacquer for wooden mallets. 

7. Marking — Mark the mallets with the following information: 

a) Trade-mark or name of the manufacturer, on the handle or head; and 

b) Designation. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — DetaWs available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi 1. 

8. Packing — Placed in wooden crates, each containing twelve mallets. Crates shall be placed rn 
wooden boxes with overall weight not exceeding 50 kg. 

9- Supply — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 



Printed at Delhi Printers. Delhi 6, India
